audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Wukong rows 3, 4, 6 and 7 and 'Skill' at Level 6, while every why on the page, the prose (early/mid/late) and the packet levelChart say the lane inverts at 6 and Kassadin owns the item rows.
audit.why: The whys were already correct (Level 3 skill, Levels 4-5 skill, Level 6 Kassadin, both item rows Kassadin) and the packet chart matches them exactly. The side/win rows were the stale layer.
audit.corrected: Chart rebuilt as a matched pair on both layers to Wukong, Wukong, Skill, Skill, Kassadin, Kassadin, Kassadin, with ratings following.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5] and phases[6] sold Black Cleaver and the 2-item window as Wukong spikes in a matchup the page itself says Kassadin scales out of.
audit.why: Rod of Ages / Seraph's is the spike that ends this lane; Riftwalk's mana tax is what falls off, not Wukong's items catching up.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why and phases[6].why rewritten to name his item spike and to say end the game before it lands.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole page was built on 'track Riftwalk's cooldown and engage when it is down'. Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2 seconds. It is never down.
audit.why: Riot's data: Riftwalk cd 5/3.5/2, cost 40 mana with escalating cost per re-cast; the limiter is his mana bar, not a cooldown. The genuinely punishable cooldown is Force Pulse at 21s rank 1 (his only slow, 400 range cone), and Null Sphere at 9s rank 1, whose shield absorbs MAGIC damage only — it does nothing against Wukong, whose damage is physical, though Null Sphere does interrupt channels.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.mid, dosFull[0], report[5].t rebuilt around mana and Force Pulse (21s). Null Sphere's shield correctly described as magic-only.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Engage only on Riftwalk's cooldown' as the central rule.
audit.why: Same as point 4 — a 2-second ultimate cannot gate an engage.
audit.corrected: Windows re-keyed to a spent Force Pulse and a low mana bar.

audit.whatIsWrong: Trading line used generic 'E'/'Q' and 'Q-shred his armor'.
audit.why: Real names, and the trade should be keyed to Null Sphere landing.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Kassadin must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but Null Sphere's shield soaks a trade and interrupts channels. Keep the wave where he must step to you.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Riftwalk's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your last clean window: deny CS and delay his 6, banking every plate. Each wave he farms safely spends part of your lead.

edits.before: Cyclone’s double knockup wins every committed brawl. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kassadin's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Riftwalk lands at 6 and it is a 5s blink — he leaves your Cyclone behind. Kill him before that or accept the lane inverts.

edits.before: Black Cleaver is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Riftwalk's cooldown.
edits.after: Rod of Ages outpaces your Cleaver — his blink chains ignore you, so shove and take map value.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Kassadin carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in, he blinks past your knockup onto carries. Kassadin carry threat 9.5/10 — end the game before this window opens.

edits.before: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Riftwalk is 5s at rank 1 and 2s at rank 3 — you cannot wait it out, only his mana can. - Force Pulse: 21s at rank 1, his only slow — engage into a spent E. - Null Sphere: 9s, and its shield eats magic damage only.

edits.before: Track Kassadin's Riftwalk before you commit
edits.after: Punish Kassadin's mana, not his Riftwalk

edits.before: His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Riftwalk is 5s at rank 1 — unwaitable. Engage on low mana or a spent Force Pulse (21s).

edits.before: Track Kassadin's Riftwalk: His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. When it is down — E-Q shred, W out, R knockup.
edits.after: Riftwalk costs 40 mana and more per re-cast — Force Pulse (21s) is the real window. When it is spent — E-Q shred, W out, R knockup.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Riftwalk: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Riftwalk is never 'down' — it is a 5s blink. Trade on his mana bar and on a spent Force Pulse (21s), and freeze to starve him off 6.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 4/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Riftwalk and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 4/10. The lane is decided by how much you deny before 6 and whether the game ends after.

edits.before: E onto Kassadin for the attack speed, Q-shred his armor, AA twice, and W-clone out as he turns to answer.
edits.after: Nimbus Strike in for the attack speed, Crushing Blow to shred, two autos, W-clone out before Null Sphere lands.

notes: The load-bearing error here was systemic: the entire page told the player to engage 'when Riftwalk is down'. Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2 seconds — it is never down, and the limiter is his mana. Also: Null Sphere's shield absorbs magic damage only, so it does not blunt Wukong at all (mirrors the Void Stone finding already recorded on Kassadin's page). The level chart's win[]/side rows disagreed with the page's own whys AND with the packet; rebuilt as pairs. No Wukong cooldowns used — ownerKit was null in this brief.
